en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a studio portrait of a woman in elaborate traditional Greek costume. She is seated on the floor, leaning against a large clay amphora-like vessel, with potted plants in the background creating an outdoor effect. The costume includes a long embroidered dress, apron, and headscarf. Printed captions at the bottom read "COSTUME GREC" and "Athènes", with a circular seal-like mark on the left and a web address-like mark at the very bottom.
